identification: Pair of Ekornes Stressless swivel recliners in navy/slate blue leather on natural beech 'Classic' round swivel bases, with two matching footstools on beech bases, and one Stressless swing-arm round beech side table fitted to one chair. Body shape (slim curved padded arms, panelled back with integral headrest, medium size) reads as an older Stressless Consul / Mayfair type, probably 1990s-2000s, size probably Medium. Leather shows creasing on seats and backs, general wear, a few marks on one seat; bases and stools look sound.

viewing_check: Look under the seat for the Ekornes label (model, size S/M/L, production date) and leather code. Check leather for cracking or peeling on armrests and seat fronts, test recline tension and swivel on both, check the swing table bracket is complete and original, confirm both chairs are same size and colour, and check footstool tilt works.
